rule: Apply only to positively identified Endesa public-network EVSEs in mainland Spain or the Balearic Islands, with connector type/power and session start time known. The whole session uses the band determined by the start time. Endesa states that some chargers can have specific prices or promotions and that the connector-level app price is final; any such exception, roaming/partner EVSE, Canary Islands EVSE, or unresolved connector classification remains fail-closed rather than inheriting the national table. Subscription prices are used only when the corresponding subscription is selected.
